info.name: IFTV
info.description:
IFTV-OTT backend APIs. One folder per feature. Every request has its body, enum values, limits and error cases in its description, plus saved example responses (success and edge cases).

**Setup**
1. Set `baseUrl` (collection variables) to the server you want: Render `https://iftv-ott.onrender.com/iftv-ott` or local `http://localhost:8500/iftv-ott`.
2. Run **Auth → Login** (saves `{{userToken}}`) and **Auth → Login as admin** (saves `{{adminToken}}`).
3. Create requests save their ids (`{{categoryId}}`, `{{movieId}}`, `{{ticketId}}`, ...) automatically, so the get/update/delete requests just work.

**Response envelope**
- Success: `{ "success": true, "message": "...", "data": ... }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "message": "...", "error": {} }`

**Common errors on every route**

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| 404 | `Invalid API`: wrong path or method |
| 400 | malformed JSON body |
| 413 | uploaded file over 2048 MB: `File too large. Max 2048 MB allowed; use the direct video upload for bigger files.` |
| 422 | validation errors (messages joined with `, `) |
| 401/403 | token missing, invalid or expired (protected routes only) |

**Bodies:** use raw JSON or form-data. `x-www-form-urlencoded` is **not** parsed by the server.

**Auth status today:** only `Users`, `Supports` (user + admin) and `Gallery` (admin routes) check tokens. In Categories, SubCategories, Banners, Movies and Subscriptions the admin checks are commented out in code.

**Images** are stored on Cloudflare Images (`https://imagedelivery.net/<hash>/<id>/public`; swap `/public` for `/thumbnail` to get a 400px version). **Videos** are stored on Cloudflare Stream (`https://<stream-domain>/<uid>/watch`).

_Last updated: 2026-10-10._

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Login, sign-up and OTP flows. **No auth header needed** on any route here. All bodies are **raw JSON**.

The token returned in `data.token` is a JWT valid for **7 days** (payload `{ id, role, name, email }`). Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The requests below save it to `{{userToken}}` / `{{adminToken}}` automatically.

**No Joi validation** in this module: only manual checks. Bad model values (invalid email, role or loginType) come back as **500** `User validation failed: ...`. Sending no body at all also gives **500** `Cannot destructure property '<field>' of 'req.body' as it is undefined.`

⚠️ Known issues to fix later:
- `role` is taken from the body, so anyone can register or log in as `admin` or `staff`.
- `register` and `login` return the password hash.
- OTP-created users all get `DEFAULT_PASSWORD`.
- A new user with an invalid email/role on the OTP routes gets 200, but the unawaited `User.create` then crashes the server.

request.description:
Creates a user with a password and returns `{ user, token }`. `name`, `email`, `role` and `loginType` are lowercased. Sets `isLoggedIn` and `isOnline` to true.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | no | no length check |
| email | string | email **or** mobile | must be a valid email (model check → 500 if not) |
| mobile | number | email **or** mobile | digits only; stored as Number (leading zeros lost) |
| password | string | yes | hashed with bcrypt; missing → 500 |
| role | enum | no | `admin` | `staff` | `user` (default `user`) |
| loginType | enum | no | `email` | `mobile` | `google` | `password` | `other` (default `password`) |
| fcmToken | string | no | push token |

Duplicate checks are **per role**: the same email can register once as `user` and once as `admin`.

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | User registered successfully |
| 422 | `Email or Mobile number any one of this is required` |
| 400 | `User with this email already exists` / `User with mobile number already exists` |
| 500 | missing password, invalid email/role/loginType, non-numeric mobile |

request.description:
Password login. **`type` picks the branch**: `"email"` (exact, case-sensitive) → email login; anything else, including a missing `type`, → mobile login.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| type | string | yes (in practice) | `email` → email branch; otherwise mobile branch |
| email | string | if type=email | lowercased |
| mobile | number | if type≠email |  |
| password | string | yes | must be a string (a JSON number → 500) |
| role | enum | no | `admin` | `staff` | `user` (default `user`) |
| fcmToken | string | no | saved if sent |

Does not set `isLoggedIn`/`isOnline` and does not check `isActive`. The response includes the password hash, and also the pending `otp` if an email OTP was never verified.

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | User loggedin successfully |
| 422 | `Eamil is required` (typo is in the API) / `Mobile number is required` |
| 404 | `User not found with this email` / `User not found with this mobile number` |
| 403 | `Wrong password` |
| 500 | `data and hash arguments required` (no password) |

request.description:
Sends a 6-digit OTP by email, valid for **5 minutes**. If no user exists for `{ email, role }`, one is created (`isFirst: true`) with the shared default password. Calling it again replaces the previous OTP. The OTP is **not** in the response.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| email | string | yes | lowercased; format not checked here |
| role | enum | no | `admin` | `staff` | `user` (default `user`) |
| loginType | enum | no | `email` | `mobile` | `google` | `password` | `other` (default `email`), used only for new users |

| Status | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | OTP sent (`data.isFirst` true for a new user) |
| 422 | `Email is required` |

Next step: **Verify email OTP**.

request.description:
Checks the OTP and logs the user in. It sets `isEmailVerified`, `isLoggedIn` and `isOnline` to true and clears the OTP. Note the method is **PUT**.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| email | string | yes | lowercased |
| otp | **string** | yes | 6 digits **as a string**: `"483920"`. A JSON number always gives 403 |
| role | enum | no | `admin` | `staff` | `user` (default `user`) |
| loginType | enum | no | `email` | `mobile` | `google` | `password` | `other` (default `email`) |
| currentScreen | string | no | uppercased, free text (e.g. `HOME_SCREEN`) |
| fcmToken | string | no |  |

| Status | When (checked in this order) |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | OTP Verification successful |
| 404 | `User not found with this email` |
| 404 | `OTP not found` (no pending OTP / already used) |
| 410 | `OTP expired` (older than 5 min) |
| 403 | `Invalid OTP` (wrong code, or otp sent as a number) |

request.description:
Sends a real OTP SMS through **2factor.in** and returns `data.otpData`. **`data.otpData.Details` is the `sessionId`**: the next request saves it to `{{otpSessionId}}` automatically. The session is also stored on the user, with a **10-minute** expiry. If no user exists for `{ mobile, role }`, one is created first (`isFirst: true`). Asking again replaces the previous session.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| mobile | number | yes | 10-digit mobile |
| role | enum | no | `admin` | `staff` | `user` (default `user`) |
| loginType | enum | no | `email` | `mobile` | `google` | `password` | `other` (default `mobile`), used only for new users |

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | OTP has been sent to your Mobile. Please check your inbox. |
| 422 | `Mobile number is required` |
| 400 | `Could not send OTP to this mobile number` (2factor rejected it: bad number, no credit, bad key; details are in the server log) |
| 502 | `OTP service is unavailable. Please try again.` (2factor down or unreachable) |
| 500 | invalid `role`/`loginType` for a new user, or non-numeric mobile (model validation) |

⚠️ Every call sends a paid SMS. There is no resend throttle yet (known issue S8).

request.description:
Logs the user in after checking the OTP. Method is **PUT**.
1. The `sessionId` must be the **latest one sent to this mobile**; a session/OTP from another phone is rejected.
2. It must be within the 10-minute window.
3. The OTP is checked with 2factor.

On success it sets `isMobileVerified`, `isLoggedIn`, `isOnline` and `loginType` (plus `currentScreen`/`fcmToken` if sent) and clears the session, so it can be used only once. Status codes match **Verify email OTP**.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sessionId | string | yes | `data.otpData.Details` from send OTP (`{{otpSessionId}}`) |
| otp | string or number | yes | the 6-digit code from the SMS |
| mobile | number | yes | the number the OTP was sent to |
| role | enum | no | `admin` | `staff` | `user` (default `user`) |
| loginType | enum | no | default `mobile` |
| currentScreen | string | no | uppercased |
| fcmToken | string | no | |

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | OTP Verification successful → `{ user, token }` (no password, no otp) |
| 422 | `Please fill all required fields` (sessionId, otp or mobile missing) |
| 404 | `User not found with this mobile number` |
| 404 | `OTP not found` (no pending OTP, or it was already used) |
| 403 | `Invalid OTP` (wrong code, or a sessionId that was not sent to this mobile) |
| 410 | `OTP expired` (after 10 minutes, or 2factor says expired) |
| 502 | `OTP service is unavailable. Please try again.` |

item.name: Users
item.description:
Profile of the logged-in user: `/users/get` and `/users/update` need `Authorization: Bearer {{userToken}}`.

Admin panel user list: `/users/get-all` needs `{{adminToken}}` or `{{staffToken}}` (user token → 403).

Token errors (same on every protected route):

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 401 | `Access Denied! Missing authorization token` |
| 403 | `Access Denied! Invalid authorization token format` |
| 401 | `Your session has expired. Please log in again.` |
| 403 | `Invalid or malformed token. Please log in again.` |
| 404 | `User not found` (user deleted) |

⚠️ `?userId=` lets any logged-in user read or update **another** user (no ownership check).

request.description:
Updates profile fields. **All fields optional**; unknown keys (e.g. `role`, `isEmailVerified`) are rejected. Changing `email` or `mobile` resets `isEmailVerified`/`isMobileVerified` to false.

| Field | Type | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | 2–100 chars, lowercased |
| address | string | max 300, lowercased (`""` is ignored, cannot clear) |
| dob | ISO date | `YYYY-MM-DD`; user must be **18+** |
| email | string | valid email; unique per role |
| mobile | number | exactly 10 digits (1000000000–9999999999); unique per role |

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | User profile updated successfully |
| 422 | `Name should have at least 2 characters`, `Address cannot exceed 300 characters`, `Date of birth must be a valid date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)`, `Please enter a valid email address`, `Mobile number must be numeric`, `Mobile number must be 10 digits`, `"<key>" is not allowed` |
| 400 | `User must be at least 18 years old` |
| 400 | `Email already exists with another user` / `Mobile number already exists with another user` |
| 404 | `User not found` |

Admin panel user list. **Auth:** `{{adminToken}}` or `{{staffToken}}` (a user token gets 403).

- Every query param is optional; send only the filters in use. Text filters (`search`, `name`, `email`, `mobile`, `currentScreen`) ignore an empty value. Unknown params → 422.
- Empty result → `200` with `data: []` (not 404).

**Subscription on every row** (same rule as movie access: dates decide):

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `isSubscribed` | `true` when a plan is running right now |
| `subscription` | running plan or `null`: `{ _id, planId, plan: { name, type, price (rupees), durationInDays, benefits }, status: "active", source, startDate, endDate, daysLeft, platform }`. `_id` is the period id used by *Cancel subscription*; `platform` only on purchases |
| `hasScheduled` | a queued renewal / grant starts after the running plan |

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | `Users fetched successfully` |
| 401 | `Access Denied! Missing authorization token` / `Your session has expired. Please log in again.` |
| 403 | `Forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.` (user token) / `Invalid or malformed token. Please log in again.` |
| 422 | `Role must be one of [admin, staff, user, all]`, `Limit must be less than or equal to 100`, `Invalid Plan Id format`, `Mobile must contain only digits`, `Is Active must be a boolean`, `From Date must be in ISO 8601 date format`, `Sort By must be one of [createdAt, updatedAt, lastActivity, name, email]`, `planId cannot be used with isSubscribed=false`, `Foo is not allowed` (unknown param). item.name: Movies
item.description:
Movies with a video (Cloudflare Stream) and a poster (Cloudflare Images).

**Auth:** no middleware is active on create / update / delete right now (`isAdmin` is commented out).

**Path styles differ:** `/:id/get`, `/:id/delete` but `/update/:id`.

Videos up to 2048 MB can go through **Add movie (form-data)**. For bigger ones use the **Direct upload** sub-folder.

**Free / paid (subscription gating):** every movie has `accessType` (`free` | `paid`, default `free`; old movies without it count as free) and `allowedPlans` (plan ids; only for paid; empty = any active plan).

*Get all movies* and *Get movie* accept an **optional** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each movie then has:

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| isLocked | true → don't play; `video` is `null` |
| lockReason | `null` | `login_required` (no / bad token) | `subscription_required` (no active plan) | `plan_not_included` (plan not in allowedPlans) |
| availableInPlans | paid movies: active plans that unlock it [{ _id, name, type, price, durationInDays }] → "Buy this plan" button |

Admin and staff tokens see every movie unlocked (send the admin token from the admin panel). A bad / expired token is treated as a guest, never an error.

3. **Check status** until `state` is not `pendingupload` (ideally `ready`).
4. **Create movie with videoUid**.

item.name: Subscriptions
item.description:
Subscription plans and the user's subscription. Plan doc: `server/docs/subscription-payments-plan.md`. Buying is in the **Payments** folder.

`type` decides `durationInDays`: weekly 7, monthly 30, quarterly 90, half_yearly 180, yearly 365.

**Money:** plan `price` is in **rupees** (GST included). Every payment amount (`amount`, `planPrice`, `creditApplied`, `payable`, `amountPaid`, revenue) is in **paise** (₹199 = `19900`).

**Buy rules** (same in quote and create-order):

| User has | Plan picked | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| no active plan | any | **new**, starts now |
| active plan | same plan | **renewal**, starts when the current one ends (max 1 queued) |
| active plan | costlier, upgrade setting ON | **upgrade**, starts now; pays price − unused value (min ₹1) |
| active plan | costlier, upgrade OFF | 409, buy after the current plan ends |
| active plan | cheaper / same price | 409, buy after the current plan ends |

The logged-in user's own plan. Header `Authorization: Bearer {{userToken}}`. Works the same on web, Android and iOS (iOS can read, but buying happens on the website).

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 401 | `Access Denied! Missing authorization token` |
| 403 | `Access Denied! Invalid authorization token format` / `Invalid or malformed token. Please log in again.` |
| 401 | `Your session has expired. Please log in again.` |
| 404 | `Access Denied! User not found` / `User not found` |

**Money:** plan `price` is in **rupees** (GST included). Every payment amount (`amount`, `planPrice`, `creditApplied`, `payable`, `amountPaid`, revenue) is in **paise** (₹199 = `19900`).

| Subscription period field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| _id | string | |
| planId | string | |
| plan | object | copy of the plan when bought: `name`, `type`, `price` (rupees), `durationInDays`, `benefits` |
| status | enum | `active` | `scheduled` | `expired` | `upgraded` | `cancelled` |
| source | enum | `purchase` | `renewal` | `upgrade` | `admin_grant` |
| startDate / endDate | date | access while startDate ≤ now < endDate |
| endedAt | date | set when an upgrade or admin cancel ended it early |
| daysLeft | number | only for the `active` period |
| amountPaid / creditApplied | number | paise |
| paymentId | string | missing for admin grants |
| previousSubscriptionId | string | the period this one renews / upgrades |
| platform | enum | `web` | `android` | `ios` |

request.description:
**Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{adminToken}}` (admin only). Before this feature the route was open.

| Field | Type | Required | Rules |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| name | string | yes | 3–120; unique per type |
| description | string | no | max 500 |
| price | number | yes | ≥ 0, **rupees, GST included**. A plan under ₹1 (e.g. 0) can't be bought, only given with *Grant* |
| type | enum | yes | `weekly` | `monthly` | `quarterly` | `half_yearly` | `yearly` |
| durationInDays | number | no | **ignored**: always set from `type` |
| benefits | string[] | no | JSON array |
| limitations | string[] | no | JSON array |
| sortOrder | integer | no | default 0. Plan screens show ascending sortOrder, then price |
| isPopular | boolean | no | default false ("Most popular" tag) |
| isActive | boolean | no | default true. Inactive plans are hidden from web / app |

Only the **first** validation error is returned. Response also has `currency` (`INR`).

| Status | message |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Subscription created |
| 422 | `Name is required` / `Price is required` / `Price must be greater than or equal to 0` / `Type is required` / `Type must be one of [weekly, monthly, quarterly, half_yearly, yearly]` / `Benefits must be an array` / `<Field> is not allowed` |
| 409 | `Subscription with this name for <type> plan already exists` |
| 401 | `Access Denied! Missing authorization token` |
| 403 | `Forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.` (not an admin) |

item.name: Payments
item.description:
Razorpay checkout for plans (prepaid, no auto-renew yet). Plan doc: `server/docs/subscription-payments-plan.md`.

**Flow (web + Android):**
1. *Quote* (optional): show what the user will pay.
2. *Create order* → pass `data.checkout` to Razorpay Checkout (web `checkout.js`, Android SDK). Saves `{{razorpayOrderId}}`.
3. On success Razorpay gives `razorpay_order_id`, `razorpay_payment_id`, `razorpay_signature` → *Verify* → plan is active.
4. If the user closes checkout / it fails → *Payment failed*.
5. If the app dies after paying, the **webhook** activates the plan anyway; *Verify* later just returns it (`alreadyProcessed: true`).

**iOS app:** don't open checkout. `platform: ios` gets 403; send users to the website.

The amount always comes from the server; the client only sends `planId`. Without Razorpay keys on the server, payment routes answer `503 Payments are not available right now. Please try again later.`

**Money:** plan `price` is in **rupees** (GST included). Every payment amount (`amount`, `planPrice`, `creditApplied`, `payable`, `amountPaid`, revenue) is in **paise** (₹199 = `19900`).

| Payment field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| _id | string | |
| receipt | string | `IFTV-YYMMDD-XXXXXX`, show to the user |
| purpose | enum | `new` | `renewal` | `upgrade` |
| plan / planId | object / string | plan copy at order time |
| amount | number | paise actually charged |
| planPrice / creditApplied | number | paise breakdown (`amount = planPrice − creditApplied`) |
| currency | string | `INR` |
| status | enum | `created` | `paid` | `failed` | `expired` |
| razorpayOrderId / razorpayPaymentId | string | |
| method | string | `upi` / `card` / `netbanking` / `wallet` (from Razorpay) |
| failureReason | string | when failed |
| userSubscriptionId | string | the period this payment bought (after paid) |
| paidAt / expiresAt | date | an unpaid order expires 30 min after creation |
| platform | enum | `web` | `android` | `ios` |

item.description:
Server-to-server. Set this URL in **Razorpay Dashboard → Settings → Webhooks**: `{{baseUrl}}/payments/webhook`, with a secret = `RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in `.env`. Events: `payment.captured`, `payment.authorized`, `order.paid`, `payment.failed` (others are logged and ignored).

The signature (`X-Razorpay-Signature`, HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body) is checked. Each event id (`X-Razorpay-Event-Id`) is processed once; a retry returns `duplicate: true`. Unknown orders are logged (200) so Razorpay doesn't retry forever. You can't call this from Postman without computing the signature.

1. **Get upload URL**: saves `{{galleryVideoUid}}` and `{{galleryUploadURL}}`.
2. **TUS PATCH** the file to `{{galleryUploadURL}}`.

request.description:
**form-data**, same fields as Update item (JSON) plus `media` and `poster` files.

- Old files are deleted from Cloudflare **only after** the update is saved. If the update fails, the new uploads are deleted and the item stays as it was.
- New `media` that is an image / gif clears the poster and duration (and deletes the old poster).
- `media` and `videoUid` together → 422. `poster` and `removePoster` together → 422.

| --- | --- |
| 200 | Gallery item updated successfully |
| 422 | `Poster is allowed only for videos` / `Send either a media file or videoUid, not both` / `Send either a poster file or removePoster, not both` / file type or size errors as in Create item |

| 401 | `Access Denied! Missing authorization token` / `Your session has expired. Please log in again.` |
